snippet.title: Travel Pack - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Pack yourself a set of dice and some comfy boots! It’s time to take a trip across a pocket-sized world of tiles, terrains and colourful characters in this light puzzle narrative game inspired by board games and travel. 

Travel Pack is our new game made by indie studio, Blackstaff Games. Coming to PC and console. 

-

We're really excited to share updates on the project with more previews, behind the scenes and exclusive. Follow us on socials and wishlist us on steam to show your support!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3571380/Travel_Pack/
